fact: The Portfolio Committee on Home Affairs reports, on the department's 2025/26 quarterly reports heard on 17 February 2026, that the development of the e-Birth system was not completed in Quarter 1 or Quarter 2 because of shifting departmental priorities, that user acceptance testing was not signed off in Quarter 3, and that the rollout of automated birth registration functionality to 47 health facilities has been deferred to the 2026/27 financial year.
title: ATC260508: Report of the Portfolio Committee on Home Affairs on the quarterly Performance reports of the Department of Home Affairs 2025/2026, dated 5 May 2026
publisher: Portfolio Committee on Home Affairs, Parliament of the Republic of South Africa
